purpose: independent recomputation of the ATLAS panel's columns from the raw SIP bars + anatomy, written to catch exactly the kind of sign/index/definition error the in-script self-test samples might miss
method: naive Python loops (no producer code path) over bars/YYYY-MM-DD.parquet and sip/anatomy/YYYY-MM-DD.json, comparing every non-trivial column of a pseudo-random row sample
bugs_this_found_and_fixed: ret_from_prevclose / ret_from_open0930 were missing the -1 (return vs ratio)
ret_1/3/5 were inverted (close(t-k)/close(t) instead of close(t)/close(t-k))
episode_low / bars_since_episode_low restarted the episode every bar (run end index not tracked)
bars_to_peak / peak_et_after_t resolved max-high ties to the last bar instead of the first
peer_new_high_5 summed peer new-high bars instead of distinct peer members
ret_percentile_candidates produced 0.0 (fabricated) when the member's own 09:30 return was missing
tolerance: 1e-9 relative for values, exact for booleans; give-back triggers compare with the documented 1e-9 relative tie tolerance
reproduce: python factory/scripts/basket_atlas_panel.py selftest --panel factory/artifacts/basket/phase2/ATLAS/panel.parquet   (the in-script check (d) is the durable, reproducible subset of this)
